environment: Chromium 156 / desktop GTX 1080 Ti, 1600x1000 DPR1, eight-second main-thread captures
method: CDP allocation sampling at 16384 bytes, including objects collected by minor/major GC; devtools.timeline GC events. Fixed-LOD runs verified identical 72 tiles and 3,196,522 triangles. Baseline source snapshot served separately against the same local data.
changes: Bounded versioned finest-tile footprint cache, including absent columns; no column result tuples.
Reusable label priority/rectangle/vector buffers; skip unchanged transform strings.
Stable maximum selection replaces repeated candidate sort; compact leaf arrays in place.
Dense active LOD lookup for labels/lights; reusable selection and eviction sets/buffers.
Reusable shadow fitting and navigation math objects.
limitations: Sampling estimates are not exact allocated bytes or retained heap. Worker allocations are excluded.
Profiler/tracing adds overhead; frame times are not uninstrumented product benchmarks.
Adaptive runs can differ in streaming/LOD admission timing. Civic adaptive frame and GC times regressed in this sample; no general FPS or tail-latency improvement is claimed.
Remaining allocations include Three.js uniforms/render lists, N8AO, moving label CSS strings and streaming result ownership.
The local dataset contains separately uncommitted vegetation changes, unchanged between captures.
stage: Intermediate allocation pass with linear-scan selection; final code uses a stable heap. Initial adaptive raw captures were superseded by the final paired captures.
